To Dr. FINKELSTEIN, 13, Shelford Park, Great Shelford.

Date of Letter 20.5.35.

SUMMARY OF CONTENTS

Refers to money paid for work done by addressee.

Also refers to certain money which has been handed over to Fraulein Karen FINKELSTEIN.

For translation see attached sheet.

COMMENT
